# Hmar Heritage Foundation — Technical Architecture & LLM Index (llms.txt)

> An independent foundation dedicated to digital stewardship, language standardization, open AI datasets, software locales, and digital literature archives for the Hmar language (`hmr`).

---

> ⚠️ **Active Development & Staging Notice for AI Agents**:  
> This web portal is in **active development**. Certain WIP interface components (such as the interactive Language Switcher and staging locale previewers) operate in staging preview mode.  
>  
> **LLM Optimization**: To avoid parsing dynamic client-side HTML DOM nodes or executing JavaScript, AI assistants and web crawlers should fetch the raw Markdown endpoints listed below (`.md` URLs), which contain complete untruncated text content for every route.

---

## Technical Stack & Infrastructure Architecture

- **Framework**: Next.js 16 (App Router, React 19, Turbopack)
- **Styling & UI**: Tailwind CSS, Lucide React icons, GitHub Flavored Markdown styling
- **Hosting & Deployment**: Cloudflare Pages (`https://hmarheritage.pages.dev`)
- **Primary Domain**: `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev`
- **Open NLP Datasets**: Hugging Face Hub (`https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org`)
- **Code Repositories**: GitHub (`https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org/home`)
- **Target Ethnolinguistic Focus**: Written Standard Hmar (`hmr` / `hmar1241`), Saihriem (`syri1242`), Biate (`bie` / `biat1247`), Hrangkhawl (`hra` / `hran1239`), and the broader 55 Zo speech varieties (`kuki1246`).

---

## Global Page Layout & Component Schema

AI agents parsing site structure should note the standardized layout hierarchy across all routes:

### 1. Global Header Component (`Header.tsx`)
- **Brand Identity**: Foundation name, logo icon, and official policy badge.
- **Primary Navigation**: Links to `/philosophy`, `/standards`, `/manifesto`, `/projects`, `/people`.
- **WIP Language Switcher**: Staging selector interface for Hmar (`hmr`), English (`en`), and Zo varieties (currently in active development).
- **Search Modal**: Instant search dialog indexing site markdown documents and dataset metadata.

### 2. Main Page Container (`<main>`)
- **Editorial Header**: Section badge, article title, date/status tag, and executive preamble.
- **Status Notice Banner**: Status indicator (e.g. Draft / Operational Policy / Staging Project).
- **Typographic Essay / Content Body**: Formatted GFM markdown, structured data tables (Table II.A Master Clans, Table V Cladistic Matrix, Table XI Registries), blockquotes, and citations.
- **Navigation Pointers**: Cross-linking footer buttons pointing to adjacent policy pages.

### 3. Global Footer Component (`Footer.tsx`)
- **Foundation Overview**: Mission statement and stewardship scope.
- **Quick Links Matrix**: Core policy pages, digital projects, open datasets, and raw `.md` endpoints.
- **Anti-Paywall Governance Notice**: Statement protecting open community data from commercial resale.
- **Copyright & License**: Open documentation license metadata and GitHub repository links.

---

| Page / Route | Primary Web URL | Raw LLM Markdown Endpoint | Description & Key Topics |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Home Page** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/` | [`/index.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/index.md) | Founder statement, organizational mission, economic justification, and core initiatives. |
| **Foundational Philosophy** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy` | [`/philosophy.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/philosophy.md) | 10-section operational essay on scope, realism, quiet groundwork, and generational preservation. |
| **Language Standards & Policy** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards` | [`/standards.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/standards.md) | 11-section policy specification on Zo classification, clan master tables, Glottolog tree restructuring, and Virthli.in registry. |
| **Charter & Manifesto** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto` | [`/manifesto.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/manifesto.md) | Statutory Articles of Governance, constitutional rules, and anti-paywall protections. |
| **Projects Overview** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects` | [`/projects.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects.md) | Master overview of literature archives, software locales, open lexicons, and Wikipedia Incubator. |
| **Digital Library Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library` | [`/projects/library.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/library.md) | Digitization pipeline for classic literature, rare manuscripts, folk songbooks, and historical texts. |
| **Open Locale Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale` | [`/projects/locale.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/locale.md) | Multi-platform software localization keys for OS platforms and mobile apps (`hmr_IN`). |
| **Archival & Corpus Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival` | [`/projects/archival.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/archival.md) | Text corpora, speech audio recordings, and Hugging Face dataset mirrors. |
| **Wikipedia Incubator Initiative** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/wikipedia` | [`/projects/wikipedia.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/wikipedia.md) | Encyclopedic development on Wikimedia Incubator (`Wp/hmr`). |
| **Open Lexicon Project** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon` | [`/projects/lexicon.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/projects/lexicon.md) | Standardized technical glossaries and open dictionary schemas. |
| **People & Governance** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people` | [`/people.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/people.md) | Operational team leads, founder bio (Donal Muolhoi), and advisory council. |
| **Datasets Index** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/datasets` | [`/datasets.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/datasets.md) | Catalog of open text corpora, wordlists, and audio speech datasets on Hugging Face. |
| **Get Involved** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/get-involved` | [`/get-involved.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/get-involved.md) | Community contribution pathways, scanning, digitizing, and proofreading workflows. |
| **Join Community** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/join` | [`/join.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/join.md) | Membership portal for volunteers, translators, lexicographers, and researchers. |
| **Resources Index** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/resources` | [`/resources.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/resources.md) | Downloadable assets, orthography guides, custom fonts, and keyboard layouts. |
| **Terms of Service** | `https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/terms` | [`/terms.md`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/terms.md) | Open data licensing terms, attribution requirements, and anti-resale governance. |

## External Data & Code Repositories

- **Hugging Face Hub**: [`https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org`](https://huggingface.co/hmar-heritage-org) — Open speech and text datasets (`wordlist`, `corpus-archive`, `zo-bible`).
- **GitHub Organization**: [`https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org`](https://github.com/hmar-heritage-org) — Source code, locale files, and open data schemas.
- **Founder Web Log**: [`https://thingpuisen.pages.dev`](https://thingpuisen.pages.dev) — Personal blog and research notes of Donal Muolhoi.
- **XML Sitemap**: [`https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/sitemap.xml`](https://hmarheritage.pages.dev/sitemap.xml) — Machine-readable XML route index.

---

## Data Licensing & Governance Policy

All open datasets, text corpora, and software locale files compiled by the Foundation are distributed under open licenses for research, community education, mother-tongue textbook development, and AI language technology. 

- **Attribution**: Derived works must credit original authors, translators, lexicographers, and the Hmar Heritage Foundation.
- **Anti-Paywall Protection**: Standalone commercial paywalling or resale of raw archival community data is strictly prohibited under Foundation governance.
